hero.title: A network troubleshooting lab in your browser
hero.lead: Real faults from small business networks: a restaurant, an office, a shop. Inspect the devices, run ping, ipconfig and nslookup, find the wrong setting and fix it. No installation, no account.
hero.comingNext: Coming next: a free-form workspace for your own networks and packet-level simulation.

open.title: Open an exercise
open.text: Each exercise starts with a message from a small business. Read the complaint and look at the network map.

inspect.title: Inspect devices and run commands
inspect.text: Click a device to see its status and settings. Run ping, ipconfig and nslookup on computers and POS terminals to see where the traffic stops.

verify.title: Fix and verify
verify.text: Correct the wrong setting and press Verify. The solution report explains what happened and how to describe it in a job interview.

exercisesHint: Start with any exercise you like.
